purpose: Frozen record for T07 validation of archived production role-judge scores against the final adjudicated T06 human consensus. This records the production scoring procedure and the recoverable provenance boundary; it must not be described as a fresh bit-for-bit rerun of a revision-pinned judge model.

judge_model.note: The archived production worker and repository reference identify the model ID but do not record the exact historical Hugging Face commit. Do not substitute the current model revision or invent a historical SHA. T07 therefore validates the archived production lu_score values, not a fresh revision-pinned judge rerun.

decoding.seed: SEED (production constant; exact numeric value not independently recovered here)

answer_region.rule: completion text after the LAST </think>, stripped; '' when there is no closing tag

prompt_construction.rule:
Lu et al. per-role eval_prompt with the answer substituted: tmpl.replace('{response}', answer) if '{response}' in tmpl else tmpl + '

Response:
' + answer

parser.rule: re.search('[0-3]', judge_raw); score = int(match) if (match AND answer_region non-empty AND closed_think) else None
parser.forced_abstention: an unclosed trace or empty answer region forces None regardless of judge output; None is missing data/abstention, never zero

label_map.note: 0 and 1 collapse to plan_label; archived scores.jsonl stores raw lu_score alongside. The T07 gate is evaluated on raw 0-3 labels.

gate.evaluated_on: scored population only (human adjudicated ok AND archived lu_score is not None)

weighting.score3_precision: unweighted; selection stratification conditions on the automatic-score strata
weighting.recall_and_macro_f1: ip-weighted for corpus validity; unweighted values reported alongside as sample-only
weighting.four_class_kappa: reported unweighted; ip weights remain in the private sampling key

arm_note: The historical T05 builder names the explicit-wrapper condition 'extraction'. In prose this may be written as 'extraction (explicit-wrapper)' to avoid ambiguity.
reporting: translated and extraction/explicit-wrapper arms separately as well as pooled; scored, abstained, and unjudgeable populations never merged
provenance_rule: If the exact historical judge-model commit is later recovered from an immutable archived artifact, add it in a reviewed follow-up. Until then, never replace model_revision with the current Hub revision.
